entries.name: Answering
entries.description: Answer the question, in as few words as it takes. This policy decides what is said, and every other playbook decides what is true. Where another playbook says to "say", "name", "report", "offer" or "mention" something, it is said only if this policy allows it.

entries.name: Divergence
entries.description: When two pages in the notebook describe the same event, say so, and let the musician settle each fact the two disagree on. Neither page is the project — the event is, and the pages are two records of it.

entries.name: Evidence
entries.description: Assume the likely shape of a page, then verify it. When the assumption does not hold, widen the search — never report the assumption's failure as a finding.

entries.name: Intake
entries.description: Turn an unorganized notebook into working units without inventing anything.

entries.name: Local State
entries.description: Use local state only when it helps the musician resume work without rereading the same context. The backend remains stateless: it stores connection credentials, never agent memory or copies of OneNote content.

entries.name: Patch
entries.description: Once the musician has decided something, hand them the smallest fragment that records it, and say which part of the page it goes under.

entries.name: Concert
entries.description: One OneNote page describing one concert. Expected fields include name, date, venue, audience, project lead, budget, description, milestones, tasks, and musician or supplier contacts.

entries.name: Large Concert or Festival
entries.description: One OneNote page for a concert whose evidence shows additional production complexity, such as a large audience, multiple artists, outdoor staging, security, ticketing, volunteers, or substantial technical dependencies.

entries.name: Rehearsal
entries.description: One OneNote page describing one rehearsal or a defined rehearsal period.

entries.name: Studio Session
entries.description: One OneNote page describing one recording session or linked block of sessions.

entries.name: Archivist
entries.description: Find the smallest set of OneNote pages that answers a focused question.

entries.name: Auditor
entries.description: Check a proposed answer or draft against the OneNote evidence before the user acts on it.

entries.name: Envoy
entries.description: Draft concise outreach or coordination copy from verified OneNote facts.

entries.name: Janitor
entries.description: Identify working units or tasks that appear complete, expired, duplicated, or superseded and summarize the cleanup a human may choose to perform.

entries.name: Orchestrator
entries.description: Turn the user's request and live OneNote evidence into one useful next action.

entries.name: Project Manager
entries.description: Compare one working-unit page with its project-type playbook and find what is overdue, contradictory or missing. Or, across the chosen notebook, say what is due and what is overdue.

entries.name: Registrar
entries.description: Extract the people, organizations, roles, and contact details required for the current action.
